entities.name: Clorinda Matto de Turner
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Clorinda Matto de Turner was a Peruvian writer who lived during the early years of Latin American independence. Her own independence inspired women throughout the region as her writings sparked controversy in her own culture. She was forced into exile to Argentina.
